content:
gallop through the sleeping town
where silence reigans over every sight

dancing,prancing,blowing down
on the wind you can go to the depths of night

lingering,a gleaming moon
as it catches a profile with its light

biting cold but shining soon
what is it that your left heand is seizing tight

content:
in this world that is falling apart,
take a broken piece in your hand
with a fire of intention there,
sew the seams as you walk
it's a structure tjat goes on and on
with no end that you'll ever see
so give up, abandon questioning;
one by one you repair

strings are broken,here's the end
and bynow you're the last needle,left alone
not forgiven to depend,
you just yield down your knees and obey the throne
mirrored on the water glass
it's a body that's covered with patches sewn
to an empty shell you ask,
is this a dream or fantasy of my own

as you're worn out you drift into sleep
drown into the red dreams of night
the fire watching the world collapses
and then burns every sky
like being hurried by something unknown,
you start walking slowly but sure
like a solitary sun that shines
over and over again

content:
no I won't let it go,all the fires of hope.

leaning on the shadows of the rock
there's a perfectly clear sky above
a wind that strokes and caresses your cheeks
softly whispered in your ears, a"good night"

fall apart,fall apart
every earthly memory going back to the pieces they were

has not yet seen the eleventh hour of disperse
what is holding back all the shapes,
barely,every fragile shape is a transient magic of yours
it's a shadow of life that cannot be replaced

in your right hand,so dead and cold there is a bouquet of gardenia held
to the memory of a soul that goes back to the earth and the soil
to this remaining world,oh lord won't you give them all despair so brimless,
and with mercy for just a while,some etenity.
